artifacts.name: low-level-design
artifacts.description: LLD for NFR-A11Y-001: keyboard navigation for Toolbar and BrickPalette components

summary.work_completed: Created Low-Level Design for NFR-A11Y-001 covering Toolbar tab navigation, BrickPalette arrow-key roving tabIndex, axe-core dev integration, and jest-axe test strategy
key_findings: Toolbar uses native <button> elements — no tabIndex manipulation needed
BrickPalette requires roving tabIndex pattern (ARIA Listbox) with useRovingTabIndex hook
@axe-core/react must be dev-only via dynamic import guard
jest-axe provides automated WCAG 2.1 AA validation in component tests
3D <canvas> is excluded from a11y audit by default

human_review_required.reason: LLD must be approved by human before implementation begins

recommended_actions: Add role=toolbar and aria-labels to Toolbar component
Add roving tabIndex and onKeyDown handler to BrickPalette component
Add jest-axe and @axe-core/react to devDependencies in package.json
Write tests for all 4 acceptance criteria (T-A11Y-A11Y-001-01 through 04)
